text: Follow the daylight to the shelter beside the solar lotus
sarathi: The hatch is responding. Take one breath, then follow the daylight.

text: Mine 3 ice — hold the left mouse button on the blue crystals
sarathi: The shelter is sound, but its tank is empty. There is ice in the rocks nearby. Use your laser.

text: Mine 6 iron ore from the rust-red boulders
sarathi: Good. Ice gives us water, and water gives us air. We need iron to build the machine that splits it.

text: Dig 4 silica — laser the ground; sandstone below gives more
sarathi: Sandstone is mostly silica. Dig into the ground below the grass — I will count what you collect.

text: Open your backpack (Tab) and craft an electrolyzer
sarathi: You have everything for an electrolyzer. It splits ice into oxygen and hydrogen.

text: Place the electrolyzer near your shelter (B, then click)
sarathi: Set it close to the shelter so its air pipes reach inside.

text: Load it with ice — walk up to it and press E
sarathi: The solar lotus will power it while the sun is up.

text: Step into your shelter and breathe
sarathi: Electrolysis complete. You are breathing. I consider that a good start.

text: Find carbon (black rocks), craft a battery and place it
sarathi: Night is coming. Solar power will fall to zero. I recommend a battery. And perhaps a blanket.

text: Survive your first night on Jivagraha
sarathi: The forest is glowing. I have never seen anything like it. Or… I do not remember seeing it.

text: Craft a smelter, load it with iron ore and carbon (E), and collect 4 iron plates
sarathi: Iron plates mean real machines. Careful — smelting makes smoke, and this world notices.

text: Craft a research station and place it near the shelter (B)
sarathi: Carrying everything by hand will not scale. A research station can work out machines that do it for us.

text: Research the auto-drill: press E at the station, choose it, load the parts
sarathi: Give the station the parts it asks for. It needs power while it thinks.

text: Craft an auto-drill and place it on rich ground — it shows what lies beneath
sarathi: The drill mines whatever is under it. Iron veins run in thin stripes; look for rich ground.

text: Research conveyors at the research station
sarathi: A drill that nobody empties will fill up and stop. We need belts.

text: Craft conveyors, press C, click the drill, then click the smelter
sarathi: A belt from the drill to the smelter, and the smelter never waits for you again.

text: Make 5 iron plates from ore that came by belt (keep the smelter fed with carbon)
sarathi: Iron plates, made while you were not looking. I believe this is called a factory.

text: Return to the escape module; press E at Prof. Huxley's projector by the hatch
sarathi: Return to the module and listen to Prof. Huxley's recording by the hatch. The factory can manage a short absence.

text: Press E to collect the translator beside the escape module
sarathi: Collect the translator beside the escape module, as Prof. Huxley suggested.

text: Follow the blue beams to find 3 memory logs; press E to read each one
sarathi: Follow the blue beams to find three memory logs scattered by the crash and read each one.

text: Press M to see the whole planet — and how healthy it is
sarathi: Our machines make smoke and stir up mud. The planet notices. Look at it from above.

text: Follow the tremor to the forest valley: walk towards the pale-green light
sarathi: Seismic tremor beneath the forest. The ground shifted, but the trees have not fallen.

text: Hold Scan beside the valley to trace the living roots.
sarathi: Hold Scan beside the valley to trace the roots beneath our drills.

text: Move every drill clear of the marked roots.
sarathi: Move every drill away from the marked roots so they have room to settle.

text: Keep working bio-filters near the smog until the haze clears.
sarathi: Supply bio-filters near the smog with water and power until the haze clears.

text: Replant bloom spores around Mooladri's exposed roots once the soil is clean.
sarathi: Replant bloom spores around the exposed roots once the soil is clean, then give the new growth time to settle.

text: Give Mooladri time to settle
sarathi: Stay a moment. The roots are loosening.

text: Walk the valley path Mooladri opened, and keep your shelter breathing
sarathi: With Mooladri calm, Jivagraha's flora now absorbs pollution twice as quickly. An excellent arrangement for everyone.
